pipeline_marker: pipeline 04-25 finished 2026-10-12 09:09:32 (final: EIA fill, baskets, CM-FDI)

headlines.source: Sector Insights summary (each sector's own source)
Clean Investment Monitor (Rhodium Group and MIT CEEPR)
EI Statistical Review of World Energy 2026

notes: Coalition: 59 economies (31 core, 28 partners); the EU-27 is one node in the Strategic network.
Trade on screen is the reconciled Comtrade matrix (importer-declared; exporters' reports x1.06 where an importer did not declare); Hong Kong is kept and tagged as a re-export hub.
Hong Kong is out of the exporter-reported Comtrade measures (RCA and the reported side of the reconciliation), as in Strategic Insights.
Critical-mineral reserves: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026.

Fossil production EI does not report separately comes from the EIA International Energy Statistics where the pipeline took it (converted to EI's units; gas and coal from EIA's latest year); where neither reports it, production is assumed to be 0 and the net balance and self-sufficiency say so (marked 'not reported separately').
Policy: IEA Policies and Measures records; Climate Action Tracker ratings where CAT rates the economy.

Sector emissions: Climate TRACE (climatetrace.org), CC BY 4.0, 2021-2025, tonnes CO2e (100-year GWP), mapped to technology x stage with a match quality per sector (config/climate_trace_map.yml); sectors with no match show the IPCC lifecycle intensity of the technology.

IEA pathways: World Energy Outlook 2025 free dataset (World), Historical, Stated Policies, Current Policies and Net Zero Emissions by 2050, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; mineral demand by scenario from the IEA Critical Minerals Dataset (Current Policies, Stated Policies, High Demand; no Net Zero scenario), CC BY 4.0; IEA scenario projections, mapped to technology x stage with a match quality (config/iea_pathways_map.yml).

Climate sources: Global Carbon Project, Global Carbon Budget 2025 v1.0 (Friedlingstein et al. 2025; consumption-based: Peters et al. 2012), national fossil CO2 from 1990 and World CO2 by fuel; Energy Institute Statistical Review, 2025 Country Transition Tracker, with the median of the economies it lists; IEA World Energy Outlook 2025 free dataset, Regions (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; regions have no Net Zero scenario); IEA Net Zero by 2050 (2021) Annex A, 2030 milestones (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO; an older edition); IEA World Energy Investment 2026 (CC BY 4.0; 2026 values are IEA estimates); config/climate_sources_map.yml. The IEA Energy and Emissions per Value Added database is licence-restricted and not shown.

Cross-border clean-tech manufacturing projects: Cleantech Manufacturing FDI Dataset (CM-FDI), P. Bandara and the Net Zero Industrial Policy Lab, Johns Hopkins University, edition 2026.10.05, CC BY 4.0; project counts and sums of disclosed capital computed by the OSI authors, no record altered; undisclosed capital investment is shown as not disclosed, never zero.

Sectors are technology x six supply-chain stages (Extraction, Refining, Components, Assembly, Deployment, Recovery): 66 headline sectors and the Semiconductors stages; each HS6 code sits at the stage of the six-stage basket. Trade is also shown by sub-component (the groups of HS6 codes a basket is built from), which add up to each sector's total; codes excluded in the 2026-10 basket review are listed per technology.
Figures a source gives once for a technology's manufacturing (manufacturing investment, IEA capacity shares) appear on both Components and Assembly and are never added across them.
Scenario dials apply to Strategic Insights only.
